# progressive

Reached only when the entry file's condition holds, which is what makes it the
progressive case.

If the script turns out to be needed at this point, run.sh is beside this file.
That line exists so one member is sighted under two load labels — directly from
the entry file, conditionally from here — because a member named outright
anywhere is directly loaded, and a rule that kept whichever sighting came first
would make the answer depend on which root the walk started from.
